video_title: Cedric Coward Walk-Off Interview | Grizzlies vs. Warriors

quotes.speaker: Cedric Coward
quotes.summary_phrase: Cedric Coward on Grizzlies' defensive adjustments and rebounding against Warriors
quotes.excerpt: defense was the main thing and rebounding. I think we kept giving them extra possessions

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: That a big third quarter allowed you guys to really open this one up. What were the biggest adjustments you made coming out of the half?

text_blocks.speaker: Cedric Coward
text_blocks.text: Defense was the main thing and rebounding. I think we kept giving them extra possessions. They had like 10 more shots than us at halftime. We were making shots, but we can't rely on our shot making. We got to lock in on the defensive end.

quotes.social_post: Cedric Coward says the Grizzlies halftime focus was on defense and rebounding after giving up too many extra possessions to the Warriors. He noted the team cannot rely on shot making alone to win games.

structured.context: Cedric Coward explains the Grizzlies' defensive adjustments and focus on rebounding during the second half against the Warriors.

quotes.speaker: Cedric Coward
quotes.summary_phrase: Cedric Coward on Grizzlies' offensive success and ball movement
quotes.excerpt: we're sharing the ball great. The ball's popping, the ball's moving, guys are taking shots

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: When you make shots at the rate you all are, you can rely on it a little bit. What has led to such offensive success over this last stretch of games?

text_blocks.speaker: Cedric Coward
text_blocks.text: We're sharing the ball great. The ball's popping, the ball's moving, guys are taking shots like we essentially take in shoot-arounds in practice. You shoot them a thousand times, you're going to eventually make them. Honestly, I think we're executing really well. We're making sure we're honed in on the details.

quotes.social_post: Cedric Coward credits the Grizzlies recent offensive success to ball movement and execution. He says the team is taking shots they practice thousands of times and staying honed in on the details.

structured.context: Cedric Coward discusses the factors contributing to the Grizzlies' recent offensive success and improved ball movement.

quotes.speaker: Cedric Coward
quotes.summary_phrase: Cedric Coward on Grizzlies' team culture and grit
quotes.excerpt: it shows just the grit and grind we have for not only our team, but our culture

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: This was a Warriors team that you faced early on in the season. Obviously they're a little different tonight, down some big players. But when you look at your team, where have you seen the biggest improvements for this group since that first matchup?

text_blocks.speaker: Cedric Coward
text_blocks.text: The first time we played the Warriors, I didn't play, but still, the guys fought like hell to get back in that game and we ended up winning. It shows just the grit and grind we have for not only our team, but our culture of what the Memphis Grizzlies are. Today, obviously, they're different, but we had some guys out too. It doesn't matter, once you're in between these four lines, it doesn't matter who's in, who's out, you got to play.

quotes.social_post: Cedric Coward on the Grizzlies culture: It does not matter who is in or out of the lineup. Once you are between the four lines, you have to play. He says the team grit and grind identity remains consistent regardless of the opponent.

structured.context: Cedric Coward reflects on the team's growth and culture since their first matchup against the Warriors earlier in the season.

quotes.speaker: Cedric Coward
quotes.summary_phrase: Cedric Coward on maintaining consistency on the road
quotes.excerpt: dissect the film, make sure you're paying attention to the details, and make sure you're not satisfied

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Five straight wins in a row for you guys. How do you keep this consistency going on the road?

text_blocks.speaker: Cedric Coward
text_blocks.text: Dissect the film, make sure you're paying attention to the details, and make sure you're not satisfied.

quotes.social_post: How do the Grizzlies keep their five game win streak alive on the road? Cedric Coward says the key is to dissect the film, pay attention to the details, and make sure you are not satisfied.

structured.context: Cedric Coward describes how the Grizzlies plan to maintain their current winning streak while playing on the road.
